notes.title: UPDATE - 2020 MotoGP™ models and liveries
notes.notes:
Discover the 2020 MotoGP™ models and liveries. The update includes some new or updated models, like the Aprilia RS-GP or the KTM RC16, and new liveries for bikes, rider suits and helmets, like the Pramac Racing team, Reale Avintia team and many others.

We have updated also the MotoGP™ physics following many of your feedbacks, making traction smoother, particularly with high TCS values, tweaked the braking and cornering phases to achieve a more flowing riding style, and slowed down lap times for even greater realism. This implies to wipe the MotoGP™ class leaderboards.  We have also addressed several AI and fuel issues and tweaked the pad vibration to make it stronger.

Discover more here: https://motogpvideogame.com/game-updates

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=N8JXYN8I_kc

notes.title: MotoGP™20 IS NOW AVAILABLE
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=gcBZtxb7FZs;full][/previewyoutube]

MotoGP™20 is out now, to give you the definitive MotoGP™ experience you ever had.
For the first time in the franchise’s history, the game is releasing almost two months from its traditional release date, to let you enjoy the new season sooner than ever.

You can participate in the current MotoGP™ Championship, racing against MotoGP™ champions, or getting into the boots of a young rider, working your way up from the Moto3™* to reach the top flight.

Take control of every step of the race with the new [b]Managerial Career [/b]that will put you into a pro riders’ boots.
Feel the extreme realism in every brand-new feature such as f[b]uel management[/b], [b]asymmetrical tires’ consumption[/b] and, last but not least, [b]aerodynamic damages[/b] that will impact bike’s aesthetic and performances.
Discover the new [b]historical mode[/b] to collect the most iconic riders and bikes and live the best online experience thanks to the [b]Dedicated Servers[/b] for an improved multiplayer mode.

And with the new [b]Neural AI 2.0[/b], nothing will be left to chance.
Get ready to race beyond your own limits.
How far you will go?

Follow us on Facebook, YouTube, Instagram to get the latest news and join the conversation: #MotoGPvideogame.


* Some contents will be updated post Day 1 to due to the postponement of the official MotoGP™ Championship for COVID-19

notes.title: Managerial Career
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=XA6lCv4k_J0;full][/previewyoutube]
The new Career Mode will put you into a pro riders’ boots, with an engaging and progressive gaming experience both on and off the track.

Just like in the real MotoGP™ simply being fast on the circuit is not enough; you will need to take the best decisions to find a winning strategy to master the Championship.

Select your Personal Manager, whose work can truly make a difference when it comes to sponsorship and contract opportunities.

You will need to evaluate all the offers you’ll receive, both from real-life teams and new teams created by you, looking carefully at their engagement and expectations before taking a decision.

If you select a new team, you can customize rider and team livery with the graphic editors. Take part in the winter and mid-season tests to develop your bike, choosing up to 3 different packs with various engines and frame combinations to find the perfect settings for the season.

You can also improve performances of different bike parts, earning and spending development points and allocating you R&D staff to reach the highest level.

Will you have your chance to sign a contract with the most prestigious teams? It’s up to you!

MotoGP™20 will be released on April 23rd on PlayStation®4, Xbox One, Windows PC®/STEAM, Google Stadia and Nintendo Switch™*.

* in the United States the Nintendo Switch version will be released on May 5th

Ready to live a pure MotoGP™ experience, from the box to the track?

Experience real world physics, more realistic graphics and all the improvements to live the thrills of the Official 2020 Season like you never have before.

After the great success of the previous chapter, the MotoGP™ videogame now goes beyond with even more exciting news and features.

Live the extreme realism in every brand-new feature, such as fuel management, asymmetrical tires’ consumption and, last but not least, aerodynamic damages that will impact bike’s aesthetic and performances.

And let your emotions run free.

MotoGP™20 will be released on April 23.
